answer: Garden mirrors stop sybil aliases. Every alias keeps one garden page, a lotus page, listing its last 12 finished jobs with requester, task, and pay, and each requester keeps a mirror page listing the same jobs. The two pages must match line for line. A garden that lists a job its requester never recorded, or a pay figure that differs, is exposed within 7 days. The alias behind a mismatched garden is suspended for 21 days and its open jobs are cancelled, so faking one job costs three weeks of work.
